method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations: Core structural gap: Slot and List are ONE record (List with statusKey free/holiday/unavailable/private/public/preop) and List.anaesthetistId is mandatory. Draft Lists (FT-01.6, US-01.6.1 to 01.6.4, US-01.4.3 move-to-office/withdraw, US-01.5.2 unavailable-becomes-Draft per OQ-27) need a nullable anaesthetist or a separate Draft List entity plus a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13). Second wrong seam: availability is a separate master reconciled into Lists (setAvailability), where the catalogue wants one mechanism; and office-booked Free slots keep statusKey 'free' (parked P5), so mobile/web, the admin drawer chip and requestCover treat them as Free while only the admin grid derives 'private'. Fixing P5 (restatus on booking, or List overrides status everywhere and remove displayStatusKeyForList derivation) closes US-01.2.3, FT-01.2 and the Free-reading part of US-01.3.3 together. Surgeon-optional Lists (phone advice, 'Surgeon TBC', EditListSheet clears) contradict FT-01.3 / US-01.3.3 'exactly one surgeon and hospital' (public acute/pre-op need a ruling). Verifier changes: EP-01 Partial to Contradicts and US-01.3.3 Partial to Contradicts (wrong behaviour present); all other grades upheld with evidence added (RequestCoverSheet copy 'notified when someone accepts' contradicts no-acceptance rule; Anaesthetist.active does not gate canvas generation; no start date on Anaesthetist). OQ-64 (logical model) is still Open, so model work should follow a settled reading; Draft List creation and the anaesthetist-move flow can be built independently. Dependencies: US-13.6.3 blacklist master (US-01.4.5, US-01.6.3), US-02.3.3 draft update email (after reassignList), US-06.3.5/US-06.5.4 prepayment re-check on moved Bookings (US-01.4.6), US-13.1.1 one-day dashboard (US-01.6.2), US-01.4.2 availability finder, OQ-65/OQ-43 notification and warning copy. Vocabulary drift: UI says Permanent lists, Card, List statuses; catalogue says recurring bookings, Booking, Slot status. Demo-script beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S1 canvas roll-forward narrative stays valid; S2 beat 2 phone-advice booking on Sharma Tue 21 PM (notes anaesthetist views still show Free; changes when P5 fixed and surgeon becomes required); S2 beat 3 illness-cover reassign stays valid (add Draft List and email offer if built); S2 availability/conflict discovery point changes if unavailability converts Lists to Draft Lists. Anaesthetist cover offer/request (Phase 03 mobile/web) would be replaced by the move flow in US-01.4.3. Prototype scale is 14 anaesthetists vs 85 (narrated, scale test exists), not graded as a gap.

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations:
Structural: EP-02 intake rests on a staged matching screen (US-02.1.2 to 02.1.4, outside this batch) that does not exist. The prototype applies HL7/FHIR messages directly to Cards (processMessage) and ingests PDF rows straight into a chosen DRAFT List. US-02.1.1 and US-02.1.5 need one shared staging model: staged hospital rows, per-hospital sync state, unmatched queue. Build once, then re-point the HL7/FHIR simulator at staging so messages stop silently applying. That reworks demo beat S1. Catalogue now puts HL7/FHIR and further feeds in EP-14 Future Work, while the prototype's only automatic intake is that simulator; decide whether the simulator stays as a Future Work demo (labelled) or becomes the sync source for fixtures.

Dependencies: US-02.3.3 needs hospital and surgeons'-room contact emails (US-13.4.1, US-13.6.1) plus change tracking from US-02.3.2. US-02.3.2 explicit save touches shared CardDetailBody (also used by anaesthetist apps): gate staged-save on the office actor (isOffice already exists there) so anaesthetist apps stay write-through. Related: US-02.5.5 (append-only history, audit exists), US-02.5.6 (concurrent edits caught at save). Open questions: OQ-69 (prompt vs on-demand button; recommended on-demand with remembered changes), OQ-65 (anaesthetist moves own List), OQ-13 (hospital download format; canned fixtures only).

Matches (FT-02.2, US-02.4.1) are sound; only the Card to Booking copy lags (AddCardFlow, Card added, Photo of paper list), best handled as one terminology sweep. Demo-guide impact: S1 (MSG-STG-1001 shows Sarah Mitchell appearing on Souter's 28 Jul list) changes with a matching screen; S2 gains a draft-email step after the reassign; S4 dead-letter/locked-target messages need rethinking if auto-apply goes; S5 PDF and photo beats unaffected.

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations: Structural: (1) No Event entity. FT-03.7/US-03.7.x need a new domain element (or Procedure variant) attached to a Procedure with own date/time, time or fixed fee, billable flag, no modifiers, an office approval step and an invoice-build path with link to the original; it replaces the B8 post-op addendum Card (store/cardActions.ts addPostOpAddendum, Card.cardType/addendumOfCardId, CardDetailBody button, DemoControlPanel stagePostOpScenario). Needs PERSIST_VERSION bump. OQ-63 and OQ-12 are Open: build against the recommendation (own element on the Procedure, own invoice line, office approval) and mark provisional. (2) 'Billed = gone' (isListBilled, M10; authoriseList bills immediately) hides every worked past List from mobile/web/WeekStrip. FT-07.4 and US-07.4.1 still say the List drops off the to-do view, but US-03.1.6, US-03.1.7 and US-03.7.1 need reachable past Procedures, so a read-only history/look-back path plus seed History as browsable Lists (older than the 14-day horizon) is the shared prerequisite. (3) Contract ownership: FT-03.4, US-03.3.1 and US-03.6.1 hinge on an anaesthetist-facing Contract picker (filtered by procedure, US-04.3.2), admin approval of the Contract selection in Review (US-07.2.2), and a Contract-required-inputs concept (US-04.2.7). OfficeBillingSetup is office-only today. (4) Primary Procedure: only implicit (first by id); FT-03.2 (corrected to Partial), US-03.2.2 and the modifier split rule (equal share when total > 4) push toward explicit isPrimary, a set-primary action, and fixing Card Copy, which currently yields a Booking with no primary. (5) Range handling: clamp plus validator block must become accept-and-warn, which depends on a warning routine (US-13.7.1; no warning entity exists). (6) NHI wording: 'NHI pending' across mobile/web/admin vs catalogue 'NHI missing'; mobile list rows blank; keep in step with the OQ-49 provisional-booking decision. (7) Persona note: anaesthetist apps run only as Dr Souter, but the post-op scenario is staged for Dr Sharma, so the anaesthetist-side event flow cannot be shown today.\n\nDemo-script impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S4 Beat 2 post-op addendum (~L303-312) is replaced by the event flow; S1 Beat 3 capture on mobile (~L125-145; Mark complete refusal and list-complete gate) changes if Contract pick and contract-required inputs become completion requirements, and the RVG range step changes when out-of-range is accepted with a warning. No automatic or time-driven triggers are needed in this epic; office approval of events is a manual Admin action. Verification changes: FT-03.2 Matches to Partial; US-03.1.6 Contradicts to Partial; the other ten gradings upheld, with corrected evidence and demo_trigger persona on the post-op items.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations: Structural: the prototype is built on the old RFP model (required billingRoute + optional governingContractId; Contract Type 1/2/3 with 'permitsIndividualArrangement'; protected default Type 1 per hospital and direct-claim insurer; insurer stored on the Procedure). The catalogue model needs (a) a master procedure list plus Contract-to-procedure/hospital association driving the picker (US-04.2.1, US-04.3.2, US-04.2.11, FT-04.3; base-unit home disputed OQ-62), (b) Contract replacing billing route as the pricing and payer decision (EP-04, FT-04.3, US-11.2.2), including exactly-one-Contract defaulting to the List hospital's RVG Default Contract, (c) Contract payment setting, split basis and multi-procedure rule (US-04.2.5, US-04.2.12; OQ-68; US-08.2.3), (d) dated price lines, versioning and review date (US-04.2.10, US-04.1.2, US-04.3.5; US-08.4.4 reproduction), (e) fee-schedule line fields and holder codes (US-04.2.4, US-04.1.4, US-04.3.2 search; OQ-66). Build 04.2.1, 04.3.2, 04.2.11 and FT-04.3 together, with EP-04 route retirement. Verifier corrections: FT-04.3 re-graded to Contradicts (insurer route defaults to the insurer's own Contract; billableParty route resolves with no Contract); EP-04 size raised to XL; noted that the 'hospital' route (labelled 'Contract holder') already invoices the Contract holder, so the old-reading conflict is route-as-mandatory-step and route-tied override. Cross-epic: US-05.3.1 (modifier split above four; prototype's isAdditional time-only rule is the old reading, drives US-04.2.5 Contradicts), US-05.4.1 (Contract-gated anaesthetist price adjustment), US-05.1.6 (procedure master), US-07.2.2 (office review flag for US-04.3.7), US-08.6.2/US-08.6.4 (credit note re-issue, additional invoices), US-11.2.2 (billable party override). Open questions (OQ-48, 62, 66, 67, 68) mean several items should be built provisionally per their recommendations. Any Contract/Procedure shape change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13) and rework of ~30 seeded Procedures in domain/seed/cards.ts. Demo-guide beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S5 beat 4 contract effective-dating (~lines 397-406) and compliance staging (DemoControlPanel.tsx:429-447) if Contracts become versioned or price-dated; the S3 exception beat relying on a group-held COS Contract with no default fallback (will not survive Contracts always defaulting to the RVG Default Hospital Contract); any beat that picks a billing route or governing Contract in Card billing setup. No new time-driven demo trigger is needed for this epic beyond a locked-Contract panel for US-04.3.5.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: Structural: the multi-procedure rule (FT-05.3, US-05.3.1) is the one wrong behaviour in EP-05, one piece of work. feeFor/splitBillingUnits work per procedure, so the fix needs a Booking-level pass (sum modifier units, then allocate equal share plus remainder to primary) feeding procedureFee/cardFee, invoiceBuild line units, Review screen B.T.M, prepayment estimate, UnitsCard captions and the additional-procedure note; modifier capture stays on the primary (the pool) while additional procedures show an allocated share. Add a 7-over-3 = 3/2/2 domain test, a seeded 3-procedure Card with 7 modifier units, and PERSIST_VERSION bump if seed changes. OQ-15 is open (Ben to validate): build to the stated rule and flag it. The Contract-level multiProcedureRule (SECOND_CODE_PERCENT, ADD_ON_FEE) is domain-model only, not in FT-05.3; it belongs with Contract stories. Base-unit home (OQ-62) affects US-05.1.1 and US-05.1.6: the prototype has only the old RVG-master reading; a Procedure master with per-procedure base units, Contract base-unit override (US-04.2.2) and a procedure-by-operation-name picker (US-03.3.1) is a cross-epic change (Master data, ManualCardForm/CodePickerSheet, resolveBtm, seed). US-05.1.1 AA-sourced codes needs an RvgCode source flag and an Add flow in Master data. US-05.5.2 depends on the pre-op/post-op event feature (FT-03.7, US-03.7.1, OQ-63) and OQ-12 codes; reuse a fixed-fee Contract (US-05.2.5) rather than a typed amount. US-05.2.5 needs ContractPrice extension (time band, add-on) overlapping US-04.2.4. US-05.2.2 and US-05.2.3 need no code change; only 'part intervals round up (assumption)' captions and the control-panel 'Billing assumption' callout can be reworded once OQ-75 settles. Verification changed one grade: US-05.1.6 Missing to Partial (low confidence), since the operation-named RVG master with base units is the old-model equivalent. Demo-guide: no S1 to S5 beat exercises multi-procedure splitting, fixed schedules or ACC pre-op lines; the S1 partial-interval-rounding discovery note would change wording. No demo-trigger button needed for any EP-05 item (all behaviour is user-driven and visible)."

epics.title: Prepayment
epics.observations: Verified from code; reviewer grading largely upheld, one correction (US-06.5.4 Partial to Contradicts). Structural shifts: (1) Trigger: prototype keys prepayment on a per-procedure patient payment category (selfFundedPrepayment on the billableParty route) with full/split detail; domain-model row 20 explicitly retires that category in favour of an anaesthetist-level prepaid RVG set (US-06.1.1/FT-06.1, not graded here), automatic at booking setup. Dropping category and split touches types, validateCardForBilling, EditBillingSetupSheet, ManualCardForm, OfficeBillingSetup, InvoiceDocument wording, seed cards, PERSIST_VERSION. (2) Money flow: trust hold needs paymentActions (pro-rata authorise on receipt), payablesActions (no procedure-done gate) and seed (INV0001 disbursed 2026-07-16, before its 24 Jul procedure) changes. (3) Refund and move: needs a credit/refund Invoice kind linked to the prepay invoice (shared with US-08.6.2), Xero credit note, and payable repoint in reassignCard/reassignList (depends on OQ-70 and the List-ownership epic). (4) Estimate: US-06.2.4/2.5 need estimated duration, a contingency-units setting and a visible breakdown (OQ-38, OQ-75). (5) Warning model: catalogue says prepayment warnings never block and should escalate toward the procedure date; prototype hard-gates completion (lifecycle.ts completionBlockersFor), with PrepaymentOverrideSheet, Card.prepaymentOverride and the review flag 'gate overridden' to rework into a soft warning with part-paid state and date-approach alert. (6) Overpaid prepayment must stop failing the billing run (negativeTotal). (7) Approve-then-send with letter templates (US-06.3.1, 06.3.6) is a new admin step. Matches: US-06.3.4 (re-check after receipt, Xero payment control Full/Half exists) and US-06.4.1 (balance netting; 'deposit' wording to fix). Demo-guide impact: S4 Beat 1 (pre-payment gate, Souter Fri 24 AM, Override pre-payment gate), cheat-sheet 'Pre-payment' section, 02-workflows 'full or split pre-payment', control-panel S4 blurb; seeded split $800 exemplar and the seeded paid prepay card (Fri 24 PM) need reworking. New beats suggested: approve-and-send with letter, cancel with refund, move with payee repoint, overpaid settlement, trust hold on Payables screen. Cross-cutting note: prototype map and the reviewer cite store/payablesActions.ts:146 for runPayables; eligibility is authorised minus disbursed greater than zero only, confirmed.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations:
Only real gap in EP-07 is US-07.2.2. The other three (07.1.1, 07.2.3, 07.3.2) are verified Matches. No bypass of the AUTHORISED lock, no Returned or recall path.

US-07.2.2 gap dependencies:
- The under-18 billable-party warning belongs to the shared warning model (US-11.2.4, with the dashboard to-do in US-13.7.2). Build it once there and surface it as a review flag here.
- Invoice email per Booking and billable party is missing from the data model (EP-11).
- The prototype holds insurer on the Procedure and frames review by billing Route plus a separate BillableParty guardian entity. The catalogue (OQ-55, OQ-54, domain-model) says the Contract defines who pays and there is no separate guardian record. This reshapes the Review Route and Contract columns and OfficeBillingSetup. Plan it in EP-04/EP-11 and have EP-07 consume it.

Terminology: UI says Card and List where the catalogue says Booking, which is cosmetic and not graded here.

Domain-model also says submitting a Booking with a warning asks a short confirm. That would touch the SubmitListSheet confirm mode but is not in an EP-07 AC.

Scripted beats: S2 (Office day: review and authorise Morrison, Whitaker, Souter) and S3 would change only if a new review flag or column appears. S5 is unaffected. If an under-18 case is seeded on a reviewable List, bump PERSIST_VERSION (currently 13) and mention it in docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md S2.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations: 14 of 15 gradings upheld; one corrected: US-08.3.2 Matches to Partial (admin payables-due and pay run read state.xero ACCPAYs, no admin balance view). Biggest cluster remains FT-08.6 (US-08.6.1 to 08.6.4): credit-in-full-then-rebill, admin free-form additional invoices and combined-procedure split are all absent. 08.6.1 and 08.6.3 are effectively one build (additional invoice); 08.6.4 sits on top and needs combination Contracts (US-04.2.11). Needs Invoice fields (kind additional/credit, parent link), a payable reversal path (negative invoice netted in runPayables, overlapping US-10.2.5 and OQ-71) and Xero sim credit-note support. Structural gap: no engine-side ledger. Invoice plus BillingCase is the record and the payable exists only as a Xero-sim ACCPAY created at handoff (authorised/disbursed truth for the pay run sits in state.xero); a derived Admin ledger view plus moving payablesDue/disbursePayables onto billing.cases would close FT-08.3 and US-08.3.2 cheaply. Cross-epic dependencies: US-06.1.1 prepaid list (FT-08.1), US-04.2.12 Contract payment setting and US-04.2.11 combination Contract (08.2.3, 08.6.4), US-04.3.5 contract snapshot at AUTHORISED (08.4.4), US-04.2.1/US-11.2.2 billable party coupling (billing route currently bundles pricing and payer; OQ-67), US-10.2.5 (08.6.2), US-09.1.4 and a new Anaesthetist GST number field (08.4.5). Terminology: Booking = Card. Shell has no screen-contextual demo-trigger slot, so contextual buttons need a new DemoContextMenu or placement on /demo/control. Demo script beats affected: S3 Beat 1 (only if grouping or invoice header changes), S4 Beat 1 (pre-payment gate narration if auto-generated held prepayment is built), S4 Beat 2 (post-op addendum joined by additional invoice; free-session-today constraint may drop), S5 Beat 4 (Regenerate check). Any seed or type change needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13).

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations: Core chain (ACCREC + DRAFT ACCPAY pair, hidden-ID contacts with ContactID cache, webhook + daily poll through one idempotent handler, unarchive) is solid and demoable. Biggest gap is US-09.1.4: the invented 5% AA service fee (domain/billing/agencyFee.ts, Xero sim 'Illustrative AA service fee' panel, ACCPAY amountPayable) contradicts the catalogue (BCTI same value as receivable, OQ-42) and no BCTI wording or ACCPAY document exists (OQ-29 wording still open). Fee removal ripples into pro-rata authorisation (US-10.2.1 wants exactly the amount received), seed history disbursements, web Accounts/selectors (mobile/PWA via shared), ~6 test files, PERSIST_VERSION (13) and demo-guide money figures (S3 money beat, S4 beat 5 quote net-of-fee amounts). US-09.2.4: the payables run is an unbadged office action that writes Disbursement directly; the epic says Xero pays and the engine detects via webhook/poll, so a Xero-side ACCPAY-paid event, poll extension and demo button are needed, overlapping EP-10 payables-run phases. Stale simulator copy: 'NHI never resides in Xero' callout calls it an unresolved contradiction though US-09.3.1 is Confirmed (OQ-30 answered). Duplicate-invoice-number callout is adequate for an Open item and matches its catalogue screenshot. Dependencies: US-08.4.5, US-08.3.1, US-10.1.2, US-10.2.1, OQ-42, OQ-71, US-09.3.3."

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations: Central defect: AA fee modelled as an illustrative 5% deduction per payable (agencyFee.ts, XeroAccPay.serviceFeeRate/serviceFeeAmount/grossAmount/amountPayable, case.authorisedAmount = net). Catalogue: payable value == receivable value, part payment releases exactly the amount received, and AA's fee is a separate monthly invoice. Removing the deduction touches domain/types.ts, agencyFee.ts, xeroHandoff.ts, paymentActions.ts (pro-rata), payablesActions.ts (full-payout check), selectors.ts paymentHistoryFor (fee/net columns), seed billing.ts + history.ts, DemoXero ACCPAY card, Web AccountsScreen Payments tab, tests (AccountsScreen, DemoXero, payablesActions, paymentActions, seedBilling); needs PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13). Do once; it closes the contradiction in EP-10, US-10.2.1, and removes the wrong model behind FT-10.3 and US-10.3.1. Then build one cluster: fee settings (US-10.3.3), monthly fee invoice entity + run + anaesthetist-visible/payable invoice (US-10.3.1, FT-10.3). Second cluster: payables run reworked per anaesthetist and period with an approve-for-payment step (US-10.2.6), net negatives and remittance advice (US-10.2.5, depends on US-08.6.2 credit flow). Payment day/weekly cycle (OQ-47) is open; do not build a cycle until confirmed. Demo-guide lines about the illustrative 5% fee and 'Net to you' (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md ~252-272) must be rewritten; payment webhook and Run payables controls already exist (DemoControlPanel PaymentReceivedCard, AutomatedJobsCard); new controls needed for monthly fee run, refund/negative invoice, approve-for-payment. Verifier check: no implementation of monthly/fee-invoice/remittance/netting/approve-for-payment found in any non-test source; reviewer evidence line numbers largely right (paymentActions authorise block is at ~131-141 not 154-165).

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: Keystone gaps. (1) No admin patient record/search screen (master data has no patients; EditPatientSheet only via a Card and cannot touch NHI or ethnicity). One new Patient screen with add-NHI, edit and per-patient invoices serves US-11.1.1, 11.1.4, 11.1.5 and 11.3.1. (2) No admin dashboard or to-do list (US-13.7.2), needed by US-11.1.5 (problem list) and US-11.2.4 (child-payer warning). The Integration monitor data-quality tab (ethnicity quarantine) is a ready pattern. (3) Billable party is welded to the old billing route in code (counterpartyForProcedure, EditBillingSetupSheet, ManualCardForm default route 'hospital', validator requires a route), while the catalogue says the Contract replaces the route step, payer is independent of pricing, defaults to the patient, and a Booking carries an invoice email. Re-grading FT-11.2 and US-11.2.2 to Contradicts; do both with US-11.2.3 (invoice email) and EP-04 Contract work, not piecemeal. The guardian as separate BillableParty record also clashes with US-11.2.4 ('no separate guardian record') pending OQ-67. (4) NHI-pending work needs an add-NHI action, an authoriseList guard (store/lifecycle.ts:277), a review/problem flag, and a seeded NHI-arrival path via the existing HL7/PDF simulator (Noah Prescott is the seed hook); NHI optional today and re-entry without NHI always duplicates (OQ-49). (5) Balance alert: only a boolean tag, post-authorisation, any payer; needs booking-time alert, age-based mild/strong from invoice raisedAtISO, admin threshold setting, and payer filter; demo clock advance already exists. Seed Grace Park has a guardian payer so a child-as-payer example must be added. (6) Insurer master is toggle-only; add/edit/retire is an S item. Demo guide beats to revisit: Prior balance tag in Billing monitor, guardian/two-funder asides (~line 242), intake dedupe (~114) and HL7 reprocess (~334) stay valid.

epics.title: Anaesthetist profile and reporting
epics.observations: EP-12 and FT-12.1 are Grouping; FT-12.2 is Contradicts only through its children (size S is roll-up glue, do not double count). Real gaps: (1) US-12.2.1 (Confirmed) flat list is contradicted by age chips, bucket columns, Overdue tab/route and the dashboard Receivables aging panel (OQ-59 answered, D8, Phase 38). Removing ageing also touches US-12.2.3 (dashboard panel, receivablesAgingFor) and US-08.3.5. Open ambiguity: whether 'unpaid payable' means unpaid by the payer (current: invoice total minus received) or not yet disbursed to the anaesthetist (US-10.1.2); today a row disappears when the payer pays and shows the gross invoice, not the net payable. (2) US-12.2.2 GST schedule is receipts-based and rolling; needs payout-date cash basis, a balance check against what was paid, and period-aligned windows; depends on US-10.1.2, US-05.2.7, and the AA fee treatment (OQ-60). (3) US-12.1.4 bank details wholly missing from type, seed, forms, table, audit labels and the payables run; HPI should be 'HPI CPN' and editable. Adding fields needs a PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 13). (4) US-12.1.2: no anaesthetist profile or settings screen anywhere (mobile More tab is static); catalogue text says the anaesthetist sets it but the captions say the office; mobile peek ignores the period; label drift Bi-monthly vs Two-monthly and raw 'biMonthly' in the Master data table. Demo-guide impact: 03-demo-script.md:57,273 (/web/accounts/overdue, 'remain under Overdue') and 01-personas-and-responsibilities.md:114 ('receivables aging'); GST beat becomes payout-based. Tests to update: AccountsScreen.test.tsx and aging selector tests. The phase plan docs (phase-26, phase-38) already anticipate all four gaps. Out of this assignment but adjacent: US-12.1.1, US-12.1.3, US-12.2.3.

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: All 11 gradings upheld; evidence re-opened and confirmed. Core structure: US-13.7.1/.2/.3 + FT-13.7 need one domain warning model (text, kind before/after, strength mild/strong, cleared flag) with a pure routine in src/domain and a store slice (bump PERSIST_VERSION). Reuse by admin to-do list, card triangles (shared CardDetailBody/ListRow so mobile, web, PWA, admin all get it) and a submit confirm. Existing precursors to fold in: reviewFlags.ts (incl. ACC-bills-patient warn flag), attentionReasons, '$' prepayment corner. Biggest correctness item: the prepayment gate (completionBlockersFor, completeCard refusal, SubmitListSheet blockers, CardDetailBody banner copy 'Completing the card is blocked') must become a warning; this is also required by Confirmed US-06.3.2 ('No block'), so it is not only a Verify-status risk. Demo-guide impact: resilience scenario Beat 1 (pre-payment gate, ~lines 288-301 of docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md, plus control-panel script text in DemoControlPanel.tsx:421 'override the blocked pre-payment in Admin') expects BLOCK then override and would change. Warning sources depend on other items: US-06.3.2 (prepayment), US-11.3.2 (patient owing, needs alert threshold, US-13.7.4 future), US-11.2.4 (child billable party), US-03.3.1 (base-unit range). US-13.6.2/13.6.3 need surgeon master expansion (room via US-13.6.1, registration, HPI CPN, blacklist with audit, pickers separating blacklisted surgeons); the warning hosts US-01.3.5 (draft assignment) and US-01.4.5 (anaesthetist hand-over) do not exist in the prototype at all, and OQ-43 is open (recommendation: short prompt without reason). US-13.1.1 unassigned Drafts depend on US-01.6.2 (List.anaesthetistId is required today). US-13.4.1 overlaps US-13.6.1/13.6.2, US-11.4.1 (insurers) and US-01.5.1 (hospital/master holiday calendars); note the catalogue's own screenshots for it caption several tables 'view only'. EP-13 ledger tools belong to FT-13.2 (Confirmed) and are graded elsewhere. No Matches among the Confirmed items except none; the two Matches (FT-13.1, US-13.5.2) were re-checked in code and hold."

epics.title: Health systems integration
epics.observations: Both items Partial, concentrated in shared ManualCardForm (src/shared/flows) so one change lands in web, mobile/PWA and admin phone-advice. Nothing contradicts the catalogue. Dependencies: US-11.1.1 (full NZHIS L4), US-11.1.2 (dual-format NHI), US-11.1.4/5 and OQ-49 (missing NHI, problem list, duplicates), US-12.1.4 (HPI CPN labelling, bank details). Cheap win: relabel 'HPI id' to 'HPI CPN' (fieldLabels.ts:121, AddAnaesthetistFlow:72, EditAnaesthetistSheet:61), no seed change. Demo guide: S2 phone-advice lookup beat (~03-demo-script.md:181) and NHI validator beat (~378-383) remain valid; making lookup fail on invalid NHI or NHI required would alter them. PERSIST_VERSION bump only if seed changes (extra canned patients are code-only).

epics.title: Non-functional requirements
epics.observations: Only US-15.0.1 in scope (status Proposed, no open questions). Closing it takes two pieces of work. (1) Role-aware capture context: hide contract name, route chip and 'FIXED CONTRACT PRICE' from the anaesthetist but keep them for office. This overlaps the billing and contract epics, so check there first. (2) A small shared in-context help component (e.g. a '?' popover in src/shared/ui) used on mobile capture, admin Day view and admin Review. Neither touches the persisted store shape, so no PERSIST_VERSION bump. Demo-guide beats are unaffected, though any beat that shows the contract line on mobile would change. Training and docs are presenter-narrated.

items.prototype_does: authoriseList triggers runBillingForList; prePaidByProcedure feeds buildInvoicesForCard, which adds a visible 'Less pre-payment deposit already invoiced' line per prepaid procedure and invoices any positive subtotal ($0 group raises none). Balance sits on the same Procedure via procedureId; the prepayment invoice is on the same Card.

items.title: Invoice the remaining balance

items.summary: When prepaid exceeds the final fee the prototype raises a negativeTotal exception and fails the Card for manual credit, instead of accepting the difference with no credit and no failure.
items.requirement_says: When prepaid exceeds the final calculated amount, nothing is refunded or credited; the difference is accepted and no credit is raised on AUTHORISE.
items.prototype_does: buildInvoicesForCard returns exception negativeTotal ('an overpaid pre-payment needs a manual credit'); the run records a failed BillingCase for retry. No credit is created, but the Card is stuck in review.
missing_or_wrong: Should produce no invoice and a clean billed Card, not a failure
Message instructs a manual credit, contradicting the rule

items.verify_note: Confirmed exception code path; AC (no credit/refund created) is technically met but the failure behaviour and message contradict 'accepted'.
items.title: No refund when prepaid exceeds final

items.summary: No trust account, and the money flow does the opposite: receipt authorises the anaesthetist payable and the payables run pays it before the procedure; the seed shows exactly that.
items.requirement_says: Prepayment money is held in a trust account as a pending payment and paid to the anaesthetist only after the procedure is done; payments out are made from the system. AC: paid prepayment, procedure not done, nothing paid to the anaesthetist.
items.prototype_does: On receipt of the prepay ACCREC the paired ACCPAY is authorised pro-rata; runPayables disburses authorised payables with no procedure-done check. Seeded paid prepayment (INV0001) disbursed 2026-07-16, before its 24 Jul procedure. No trust balance or view.
missing_or_wrong: No trust account concept, balance or ledger view
Payable released on receipt, not on procedure done (fails the AC)
Seed disbursement predates the procedure

items.verify_note: Re-read runPayables eligibility (authorised minus disbursed only) and seed disbursement dates.

items.summary: Cancelling a Booking only soft-cancels the Card; the prepayment invoice, receipt and payable are untouched and nothing is refunded or credited.
items.requirement_says: Cancelling a Booking with a paid prepayment before the procedure refunds the original prepayment in full from the trust account, recorded as a ledger credit linked to the prepayment invoice, handled by the office.
items.prototype_does: cancelCard sets Card.cancellation and excludes the Card from billing; cardRequiresPrepayment then returns false so the banner vanishes. No credit/refund record, no credit-note Invoice kind, no link to the prepayment invoice; paid ACCREC and possibly disbursed ACCPAY remain.
missing_or_wrong: No refund action or ledger credit linked to the prepayment invoice
No credit-note kind on Invoice (kind is standard|prePayment only)
Paid prepayment silently orphaned on a cancelled Card, payable may already be disbursed
No office refund task or Xero credit note

Needs a seeded paid-prepay Booking not yet done (the current seed one is on a booking that would need re-timing).

items.summary: A new Booking under a different anaesthetist can be prepaid separately at that anaesthetist's unit value, but there is no refund of the original, no automatic estimate and no rebook link. OQ-70 covers the move/cancel distinction.

items.prototype_does: Each Card gets its own prepay invoice via feeFor using the List's anaesthetist unit value, so a new Card under another anaesthetist is priced at their rate once the office sets the category and clicks Raise. Original not refunded.
missing_or_wrong: Refund of the original prepayment (US-06.5.2) absent
New prepayment is manual, not auto-estimated (US-06.2.4)
No cancel-and-rebook link or note that two estimates may differ

items.title: Prepayment for a replacement anaesthetist

items.summary: Moving a prepaid Card does not raise a second invoice, but the prepayment's payable stays pointed at the original anaesthetist (fixed at Xero handoff), so the first anaesthetist can be paid the prepaid amount for a procedure the second does; nothing is re-checked or shown. OQ-70 open.
items.requirement_says: A prepaid Booking moved to another anaesthetist before the procedure keeps the agreed amount, no new prepayment invoice, the draft payable is repointed to the new anaesthetist, who is paid the prepaid amount.
items.prototype_does: reassignCard only changes Card.listId. The pre-invoice and its ACCREC+ACCPAY pair already exist with payee resolved from the original list's anaesthetist; raise is refused as alreadyRaised so no second invoice. The balance run on B's list nets the prepaid amount at B's rate, while the prepaid payable still goes to A.
missing_or_wrong: Draft payable stays on anaesthetist A (AC2 and AC3 fail); implemented payee outcome is wrong, not just absent
No re-check or message on move about the agreed amount
No second invoice only by accident (idempotent raise), not as a stated rule (AC1 met)
Once receipt authorised the payable, no repoint possible; no demo of the move on a prepaid Card
items.demo_trigger: Admin 'Move Booking' to another anaesthetist's List: card banner shows 'Prepayment kept at agreed amount, payee now Dr B' and the Xero demo shows the draft ACCPAY contact changed to B.
items.verify_note: Re-graded Partial to Contradicts: AC1 holds, but the payable pair stays on anaesthetist A after a move, which is implemented behaviour that is wrong (pays the first anaesthetist), same standard as US-06.5.1. Medium confidence since the move-with-prepay path is incidental rather than a designed behaviour.
items.title: Prepaid Booking moved to another anaesthetist

items.summary: Admin Review screen lets the office check route, Contract, code, times and flags per Booking and correct billing setup before Authorise (approval at SUBMITTED, per OQ-26). Missing: under-18 billable-party warning, invoice email and address review, insurer details and every Procedure's Contract on the review row, and an explicit Contract approval step.
items.requirement_says: At SUBMITTED review the admin checks each Booking's Procedures, the Contract selected for each, whether an insurer's Contract is needed and the insurer details, references, addresses, invoice emails, and anything missed or wrong. The admin approves or corrects the Contract selections, and gets a mild non-blocking warning for a patient under 18 who is the billable party (US-11.2.4).
items.prototype_does: ReviewScreen shows a row per non-cancelled card (Time, Patient, Route, Contract, Code, Times, B/T/M, Units, Fee, Flags). The Contract column is the first procedure's governing Contract only, and Route shows 'Mixed' when procedures differ. Flags are not-completed, pre-payment outstanding or overridden, no billing reference, ACC billed to patient, and manual B/T/M override. The office can open a card on a SUBMITTED List and use OfficeBillingSetup to edit route, insurer, category, guardian payer, Contract, reference, price override and funder split. Log phone note exists. 'Authorise for billing' is the only approval and is not gated by flags. Review happens after submit, as OQ-26 says.
missing_or_wrong: No under-18 check anywhere: ageYears exists in shared/format.ts and is only displayed on card detail. No flag, warning or to-do when a patient under 18 is the billable party, and nothing distinguishes a hospital billable party (US-11.2.4 ACs: raised, not raised for a hospital, clearable by admin).
No invoice email on any entity: grep for invoiceEmail and 'invoice email' in non-test, non-seed src finds nothing. The review screen also shows no billable-party or patient address or email.

Insurer details are not on the review table. Insurer is held on the Procedure (procedure.insurerId, shown only inside OfficeBillingSetup), whereas OQ-55 says neither Patient nor Booking holds it and each Procedure's Contract says who pays.
Contract column shows only the first Procedure's Contract (ReviewScreen primaryView), so a Booking whose Procedures sit on different Contracts cannot be reviewed at a glance.
No explicit 'approve Contract selections' action or per-Booking approved marker. Approval is implicit in Authorise.

Review is framed by billing Route (hospital / billable party / insurer), while domain-model says there is no separate route step and the Contract defines the billable party. The guardian is a separate BillableParty entity (billablePartyActions), whereas US-11.2.4 says there is no separate guardian record. Both belong to EP-04/EP-11 but shape this screen.
No dashboard to-do or warning model for the under-18 warning to appear in or be cleared from. It is built elsewhere (US-11.2.4, US-13.7.2) and surfaced here.

aa-prototype/src/shared/card/OfficeBillingSetup.tsx:51-80 (insurer on procedure, Route rows, guardian payer)

The review row shows a mild 'Patient under 18 is the billable party' pill and the same warning appears in the dashboard to-do (once built), where it can be cleared. No new button needed. The row also needs a hospital-billable minor on another List to show the no-warning case.

Confirm overlay, then 'List authorised · locked for billing' banner with invoice count; rows lock. Procedure holds only governingContractId (live reference, no version); invoice lines snapshot rate detail into descriptions at run time, and the run is synchronous so effective freeze is at authorise.

items.title: Authorise the List

items.summary: Every Booking and Procedure write path goes through editRefusal, which rejects all actors once a List is AUTHORISED. Admin shows locks and the Data Inspector guard console demonstrates the refusal.
items.requirement_says: The system rejects any attempt to edit an AUTHORISED List's Bookings or Procedures so the record handed to the Billing/Invoice Engine never changes.
items.prototype_does: editRefusal returns 'listAuthorised' first, for anaesthetist, office and integration alike. It gates editCard, editProcedure, editList, createCard, copyCard, addProcedure, removeProcedure, cancelCard, complete and uncomplete, intake/patient edits and the billing-line and funder-allocation actions. reassignList and reassignCard refuse an AUTHORISED source or target. Pre-payment raise and override refuse AUTHORISED. Integration messages hitting a locked List go to manual intervention. UI: card body read-only, Review rows dimmed with lock icons and 'Authorised · locked'. The guard console on the Data Inspector can run editCard or cancelCard as any persona against an authorised card and prints the refusal.

items.summary: Engine resolves route/contract itself and reprices from live masters, including a default-contract fallback, instead of reading a contract locked at authorisation.

items.summary: Core Xero mirror (ACCREC + draft ACCPAY pair, webhook + daily poll, hidden-ID contacts, archiving) is built; the epic's resilience and divergence discussion (async queue, auto-retry with backoff, alerting, Xero-side void/amend drift) is not represented.
items.requirement_says: Dedicated Xero org under the engine (not system of record) mirrors an ACCREC and draft ACCPAY per ledger pair, detects payment by webhook plus daily poll, uses hidden-ID contacts. Proposed resilience: async processing, durable queue with exponential-backoff retry, idempotency, handling of engine/Xero divergence (voided/amended in Xero, payment against a credited invoice), failure/recovery testing.
items.prototype_does: Handoff is synchronous inside one mutate after the billing run. A single armed fault (settings.failNextHandoff) records handoffFailure on the case, shown in Billing Monitor with a manual 'Resolve & retry'. Webhook and poll are simulated. No queue, no automatic retry/backoff, no outage or alerting, no drift detection. XeroAccRec 'voided' is typed and rendered but nothing ever sets it. Idempotency is present (accRecId no-op, per-payment key).
missing_or_wrong: No Xero outage / slow-API simulation showing the user flow unblocked while events queue

items.prototype_does: BillingCase holds receivedAmount/authorisedAmount/disbursedAmount and paidInAtISO/disbursedAtISO independently; admin InvoiceDocument chips (Paid into AA / Part paid / Disbursed / Part disbursed / Not yet disbursed), Billing Monitor MoneyDetail shows same pair, web Payments status pills.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Control panel 'Payment received (webhook)' then 'Run payables'; Xero 'Simulate payment and payout'.
items.verify_note: Re-checked chips and store writes; states independent. 'Ledger pair' is a BillingCase mirror not the EP-08 ledger entity; that gap belongs to EP-08. 'Fully disbursed' currently compares to fee-reduced payable; changes when US-10.2.1 fix lands.
items.title: Two payment states

items.summary: Release logic (full releases whole, part releases proportional share, remainder outstanding on receivable) works, but the released payable is net of a 5% fee so it never equals the amount received.
items.requirement_says: Paid receivable authorises the matching payable into the next run; full payment releases the whole payable; part payment releases a payable for exactly the amount received, remainder stays outstanding on the receivable. Payment day/cycle (OQ-47) unsettled.
items.prototype_does: receivePayment authorises cumulative pro-rata of ACCPAY.amountPayable (net of 5% fee), idempotent via payment key (webhook and poll); ACCREC received/balance update; payables run disburses only the increment. Simulator shows unpaid, paid and half-payment states; Admin shows payables waiting.
missing_or_wrong: Authorised amount = received x 0.95 (fee deducted), not exactly the amount received; full payment releases 95% of the receivable, not the whole payable value
Web Payments history shows Customer paid / AA fee / Net to you, presenting the deduction as the norm
Payment day/cycle (OQ-47: Tue/Wed run or weekly) not represented; run is on-demand only (open question, low weight)
items.demo_trigger: Existing: control panel 'Payment received (webhook)' (Full / Half) and 'Run payables'.
items.verify_note: Verdict upheld (Confirmed-status; fee deduction contradicts 'exactly the amount received'). Corrected size S -> M: the fix is removing the fee deduction across types, handoff, pro-rata, seed, selectors, simulator and Web Payments tab, which is the same shared work as EP-10 (do once). Added the Web Payments columns point.
items.title: Payable released to match the amount received

items.summary: Every receipt (webhook or poll) is reconciled to its billing case/invoice and displayed against the invoice; poll catches missed webhooks.
items.requirement_says: Every receipt recorded in Xero is reconciled back to the ledger record it belongs to, keeping the internal ledger (system of record) in step with Xero.
items.prototype_does: receivePayment (shared by webhook and poll, idempotent by key) writes PaymentIn, updates ACCREC, BillingCase and a BillingReceipt keyed to case/ACCREC; runReconciliationPoll on dayAdvanced re-detects unmirrored Xero payments and applies them via the same handler with the original receipt date. Web Payments shows receipt against invoice number; Xero pair shows engine link.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Control panel 'Run reconciliation poll' and day advance catch the seeded missed-webhook payment.
items.verify_note: Confirmed Status: Confirmed item; re-read poll and receivePayment. 'Ledger as system of record' (US-08.3.2) is an EP-08 gap; here the BillingCase mirror stands in. Confidence stays medium for that reason.
items.title: Reconcile back to the ledger

items.summary: No bulk hospital remittance or Xero bank-reconciliation representation; only single-invoice payment simulation.
items.requirement_says: Bulk hospital payments covering many invoices are matched by Xero's bank reconciliation and remittance add-on, not by the engine; items the add-on cannot match stay as unmatched items in Xero's bank reconciliation for office staff.
items.prototype_does: Nothing functional. Payments are simulated one ACCREC at a time. DemoXero has only a warn Callout that unique InvoiceNumber can be the remittance matching key.
missing_or_wrong: No bulk-payment simulation across several ACCRECs
No Xero-side 'unmatched item' list or bank-reconciliation view
No explicit statement that the engine does not do bulk matching (scope callout)
evidence: searched: 'remittance|bank reconc|unmatched|bulk' in src -> only DemoXero.tsx:63-68 callout text; other hits are unrelated (feeds.ts, integrationActions.ts appointment matching)
items.demo_trigger: Proposed: on Xero simulator Invoices tab, button 'Simulate bulk hospital remittance' that pays several open ACCRECs of one hospital in one action (each through receivePayment, source 'webhook') and leaves one item in a 'Xero bank reconciliation: unmatched' list marked 'For office staff, handled in Xero'.
items.verify_note: Missing verdict upheld after grepping remittance/bank/unmatched/bulk. Size raised S to M: the unmatched item needs persisted state (store slice, possibly seed and PERSIST_VERSION bump), a simulator action and UI, plus tests. Added store surface.
items.title: Bulk remittance stays in Xero

items.summary: No negative invoices, no netting in the payment run and no remittance advice; every payable is disbursed individually.
items.requirement_says: A negative invoice (refund or credit after invoicing) is netted against the anaesthetist's positive payables in the next payment run; payment is the net total; remittance advice shows the negative netted against the positives. OQ-71 open on the no-later-payment case.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. Disbursements are one record per ACCPAY; a negative invoice total is refused as a billing validation error; no credit-note/refund flow and no remittance advice.
missing_or_wrong: No negative invoice / credit-after-invoicing / refund entity (invoiceBuild refuses negativeTotal)
Payables run does not group per anaesthetist or net negatives against positives
No remittance advice for a run (Web or Admin)
No handling of an unrecoverable negative balance (OQ-71)
evidence: searched: remittance|negative invoice|credit note|netting|netted in src (excl tests) -> only comments (DemoXero.tsx:66, mutate.ts:78 invoiceNumber as remittance key)
items.demo_trigger: Admin Billing Monitor control 'Raise refund (negative invoice)' on an already-disbursed invoice (also control-panel 'Seed refund after payment'); 'Run payables' then shows a per-anaesthetist net line (e.g. 19 positives + 1 negative) and Web Accounts gains a Remittance advice for the run listing the negative netted.
items.verify_note: Searched hard for refund/credit/negative/netting/remittance implementations: only comments about remittance keys. Missing stands. Depends on US-08.6.2 credit flow.
items.title: Negative invoices netted in the payment run

items.summary: Only authorised payables enter the run (so unapproved ones are excluded), but there is no payment-period grouping or explicit approve-for-payment step; whether this equals US-10.2.1 authorisation is unresolved (OQ-47).
items.requirement_says: After AA generates a payment period's BCTIs they are approved for payment before payout; unapproved BCTIs are not in the payment run.
items.prototype_does: ACCPAY is created as draft at handoff and only becomes authorised when its ACCREC is paid; payablesDue/runPayables include only authorised-undisbursed amounts. No separate approval step, period or approver.
missing_or_wrong: No payment-period grouping of BCTIs
No explicit approve-for-payment action or approver (admin or system) before the run
Weekly trust-account cycle (OQ-47) not represented
evidence: searched: approve.*pay|payment period|weekly in src (excl tests) -> none relevant
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Approve period's BCTIs' on the Admin Billing Monitor payables-run card (and in control panel): moves generated BCTIs from 'Awaiting approval' to 'Approved'; 'Run payables' then pays only approved ones.
items.verify_note: The single AC (unapproved BCTIs not in run) is satisfied incidentally by draft/authorised status, so not Missing; the approve step is absent, so not Matches. Status is Verify and OQ-47 is open, so confidence medium.
items.title: Approve the period's BCTIs for payment

missing_or_wrong: Percentage-of-payable model must be removed (catalogue screenshot labels it superseded)
No monthly fee invoice run action
No BCTI count per anaesthetist per month
Fee invoice not tracked in ledger or shown to anaesthetist/admin
AC example ($700) not reproducible
evidence: searched: feeInvoice|monthly run|BCTI in src (excl tests) -> none

items.verify_note: Confirmed no monthly run or BCTI count in code; the catalogue's own screenshot caption marks the percentage model superseded, supporting Contradicts.

Missing: no Contract-defined billable party (OQ-55 answer); Contract holderType 'billableParty' exists but payer is not derived from the Contract
Per-Procedure rather than per-Booking is NOT itself wrong: OQ-55 lets one Booking carry Procedures with different payers, so reviewer's 'payer is per Procedure' point dropped
evidence: aa-prototype/src/domain/billing/invoiceBuild.ts:192-217 (counterpartyForProcedure: route first, billablePartyId only on billableParty route)
searched: invoiceEmail|billingEmail|recipientEmail in src -> none; docs domain-model.md:14,40,138

items.requirement_says: Single day, every anaesthetist's AM and PM Slots with status and, where a List sits, hospital, surgeon and booking count; Draft Lists for the day appear as unassigned (no anaesthetist yet); drill into any List.
items.prototype_does: One row per anaesthetist; block shows hospital + surgeon(+specialty) or status label; click opens ListDrawer with card list. Count of cards only inside drawer. Every List requires an anaesthetistId, so no unassigned row exists.
missing_or_wrong: Booking count not shown on the day-grid block (GridBlock shows only l1/l2 text plus ! / note dot / $ marks)
Draft Lists with no anaesthetist are not shown or representable (List.anaesthetistId required); no unassigned row or area (depends on US-01.6.2)
evidence: searched: unassigned|draft list rows in apps/admin -> none
items.verify_note: Re-read GridBlock and List type: both gaps real. Booking count alone is S; unassigned Drafts need the US-01.6.2 draft model so M overall (and overlaps that phase).
items.title: One-day dashboard

items.summary: Tomorrow is reviewed in the same day view via next-day/date navigation; no tracked state or gate exists, which is what the story wants.
items.requirement_says: Admins review tomorrow's Lists in the same day view with no tracked state, gate or step.
items.prototype_does: DayNav prev/next/date input on the same grid; nothing records a pre-op review and nothing blocks List progress.
evidence: searched: tomorrow|pre-op review|preOp in apps/admin and store -> no review-tracking state (preop is only a session status)
items.verify_note: Checked for hidden gates or a review flag on lists: none. Story is a negative requirement and is satisfied. Status Proposed, not Confirmed.
items.title: Pre-op review of tomorrow

items.summary: No Admin ledger balance view: no whole-ledger totals or imbalance, no per-anaesthetist position in Admin. Only a payables-due panel exists in Billing monitor; per-anaesthetist balance selectors feed anaesthetist apps only.
items.requirement_says: Admins see ledger position for the whole ledger (receivables outstanding, receipts held, payables due, amounts disbursed, imbalance) and per anaesthetist (owed to them, they owe) via the same balance view scoped. Confirmed; detail to be worked out later.
items.prototype_does: Billing monitor 'Run payables' panel shows count and $ of authorised payables due. Per-anaesthetist outstanding ACCPAY, aging and GST selectors exist but are used only by anaesthetist mobile Balances and web Accounts/Dashboard. Money model is BillingCase + Xero mirror, not an internal ledger.
missing_or_wrong: No whole-ledger view (receivables outstanding, receipts held, payables due, disbursed)
No imbalance figure or in/out-of-balance indicator
No Admin per-anaesthetist ledger position (picker + same balance view)
No internal ledger system of record (DM-18/DM-19 dependency)
evidence: searched: imbalance|out of balance|receiptsHeld|ledger in aa-prototype/src -> none relevant
items.demo_trigger: Control Panel button 'Inject unmatched receipt' (or 'Force imbalance'), shown only on the new Admin Ledger balance screen: records a Xero payment with no matching receivable so the imbalance figure goes non-zero. Existing Xero simulator 'payment received' and Admin 'Run payables' already move receipts and disbursed.
items.verify_note: Confirmed no ledger screen or nav item. Partial is generous (one of five figures exists as an action panel) but defensible; kept. Cheaper interim: derive from existing BillingCase/Xero mirror selectors, full internal ledger is DM-18 (EP-08).
items.title: Ledger balance views

items.summary: Only a boolean 'Prior balance' tag on the Billing monitor; no patient record in Admin and no balance amount or invoice list.
items.requirement_says: Admins see a patient's outstanding balance from their profile (US-11.3.1: all their invoices, paid / part paid / unpaid, across every anaesthetist). Confirmed.
items.prototype_does: patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode marks a card's patient with a 'Prior balance' tag in Billing monitor; tooltip notes open vs overdue not distinguished. Card detail shows no balance.
missing_or_wrong: No patient profile/search screen in Admin
No outstanding balance amount or list of the patient's invoices across anaesthetists
No paid/part paid/unpaid breakdown
evidence: searched: outstanding in apps/admin and shared/card -> only prepayment status and the prior-balance tag
items.verify_note: Borderline Partial vs Missing: the tag is an intake proxy, not a profile view. Kept Partial since it does surface 'patient has unpaid prior bill' to the office. Shares the patient record work with EP-11 US-11.3.1; build once.
items.title: Per-patient balance

items.summary: Billing monitor shows per AUTHORISED List the billing run, invoices, emailed and Xero stages with failure reasons.
items.requirement_says: For every AUTHORISED List, show whether invoiced, sent to billable party, mirrored to Xero; show why any step failed.
items.prototype_does: Pipeline card per authorised List: List authorised -> Billing run -> Invoices generated -> Emailed -> Xero, per-card status pills and failure/handoff-failure messages; nav badge for attention count.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Control Panel 'arm handoff fault' and Authorise flows (S3/S4) produce failed rows.
items.verify_note: Re-read selector and screen: lists filtered to AUTHORISED (backdrop seed excluded), stages and reasons present, insurer portal handled. Note: monitor is built on the old BillingCase model and will need rework if DM-18 lands, but behaviour matches the story as written.
items.title: Processing monitor

items.summary: Resolve & retry on failed billing-run and Xero-handoff items exists, with reason shown and outcome visible.
items.requirement_says: Admins can resolve a failed item and retry it.
items.prototype_does: Per-card 'Resolve & retry': clears contract end-date fault then retryBillingCase then handoffCase; handoff faults re-run handoffCase; office only, audited.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Control Panel 'arm handoff fault' and the contract end-date scenario.
items.verify_note: retryBillingCase guards office-only and failed-only; both failure kinds have a retry path. Catalogue images match the prototype flow.
items.title: Manual intervention

items.summary: Master data screen covers anaesthetists, contracts, permanent lists, hospitals + holidays, insurers, RVG, modifiers, statuses, but several listed tables are absent and most are view-only.
items.requirement_says: Admins maintain all reference data in one place: hospitals (with contact email), surgeons and surgeon groups, surgeons' rooms, insurers, anaesthetists, slot statuses, recurring bookings, master public-holiday calendar plus each hospital's calendar, RVG codes and groups, modifier codes, Contracts.
items.prototype_does: 11-view MasterData: Anaesthetists (edit/add), Contracts (CRUD), Permanent lists (add/edit), Hospitals and per-hospital holidays (add only), Surgeons / Organisations / RVG / Modifier / List statuses read-only, Insurers direct-claims toggle only, Xero archiving settings.
missing_or_wrong: Hospital is {id,name}: no contact email for booking updates
No surgeon groups and no surgeons' rooms master (US-13.6.1)
No RVG groups
No master (national) public-holiday calendar, only per-hospital holidays

Surgeons, RVG codes, modifier codes and slot statuses are view-only (note: the catalogue's own screenshot captions label these 'view only', so edit may not be required; the added fields are the clear gap)
Hospital holidays cannot be edited or deleted; hospitals cannot be renamed or deleted; insurers cannot be added or edited beyond the toggle
evidence: searched: contactEmail|surgeonGroup|rvgGroup|masterHoliday|publicHoliday|room in domain/types.ts and store -> none
items.verify_note: Re-checked types and actions: no implemented behaviour contradicts the story, so Partial not Contradicts. Softened the view-only point since catalogue screenshots for this Confirmed story are captioned view only. Overlaps US-13.6.1/13.6.2 for rooms/surgeons.
items.title: Maintain reference tables

Build together with US-13.4.3 loader.

items.title: Reference data loaded from controlled spreadsheets

items.summary: Rights granted by role (anaesthetist, office, integration, system) with a Roles overlay and store-guard enforcement; guard tester in Data Inspector shows refusals.
items.requirement_says: View, edit and approval rights by role rather than individual users, further roles as needed; enforced at the service layer.
items.prototype_does: RolesInfo overlay lists view/edit rights per role; store guards refuse by actor.role (e.g. authoriseList office only); anaesthetist apps scoped to own data; Data Inspector guard tester lets a role attempt complete/cancel/edit/submit/authorise and shows the refusal.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Data Inspector guard tester (Demo Data) and persona switch.
items.verify_note: Re-read RolesInfo and guards. Roles are fixed, not user-assignable, but story needs role-based (not per-user) rights only; domain-model-delta DM-33 was likewise refuted. Catalogue screenshots for this story are the prototype's own Roles overlay and guard refusal.
items.title: Role-based access

items.summary: Global append-only audit viewer shows who, role, source and what changed across creates, updates, reassignments, authorisations, invoices, payments and disbursements, manual and automated.
items.requirement_says: Admins can see who or what made every change and when (creates, updates, reassignments, authorisations, invoices, payments, disbursements), manual and automated; temporal tables are the backend mechanism.
items.prototype_does: All mutations audited via mutate(); AuditViewer lists newest first (cap 500) with entity, source (anaesthetist/office/integration/system/demo) and date filters; columns At, Action label, Who, Role/source, Entity, Change summary. Labels cover list.reassign, list.authorise, invoice.create, xero.paymentReceived, xero.disbursed, card.create/update.
evidence: aa-prototype/src/store/lifecycle.ts:772 (availability.set audit, no friendly label, falls back to derived text)
items.verify_note: Re-opened viewer and label map: every listed change class has a labelled audit action and automated sources (system/integration) are filterable. Temporal tables / point-in-time are backend technical discussion, narrated. Story has no AC. Unlabelled availability actions fall back to a derived readable label, cosmetic only.
items.title: Audit trail of all actions

items.summary: No surgeons' room entity; surgeons not linked to rooms; hospitals and rooms hold no contact email.
items.requirement_says: Master list of surgeons' rooms: name, contact email and phone, surgeons belonging to it; each surgeon linked to a room, room contacts shown on the surgeon profile; room email feeds booking-update emails, missing-NHI and duration requests.
items.prototype_does: Nothing
missing_or_wrong: No SurgeonRoom entity, list or editor
Surgeon-to-room link absent
No room contact email/phone
Room contacts not shown on surgeon profile
Room email not used as To address anywhere (US-02.3.3 dependency)

items.title: Surgeons' rooms master record

items.summary: A surgeon master record exists (id, name, specialty, view-only list) but no profile page, room, NZ registration number, HPI CPN or blacklist.
items.requirement_says: Each surgeon has an Admin App profile page recording name, room, NZ medical registration number, HPI CPN and the blacklist of anaesthetists; a surgeon is one identified record, like an anaesthetist profile.

missing_or_wrong: No surgeon profile screen (no add/edit action in store)
No room, NZ registration number or HPI CPN fields
No blacklist on the profile (US-13.6.3)
evidence: searched: surgeon profile|hpiCpn|surgeon registration|createSurgeon in src -> none

items.title: Surgeon profile

items.summary: No blacklist of anaesthetist/surgeon pairings anywhere, no soft warnings on assign or hand-over; OQ-43 (what the anaesthetist sees, one list or two) unresolved.
items.requirement_says: Admins record blacklist entries (anaesthetist + surgeon, optional reason) on a surgeon's profile, can end entries with history kept, blacklisted surgeons are shown separated when choosing, and a soft warning (never blocks) shows when a Draft List is assigned and when an anaesthetist hands a List to a colleague.
items.prototype_does: Nothing. Only an advisory 'different hospital / different surgeon' flag in the admin Move Card flow.
missing_or_wrong: No blacklist data, entry/end UI or audit
No separated blacklisted surgeons in pickers

No soft warning on assigning a (Draft) List (US-01.3.5) or on anaesthetist hand-over (US-01.4.5); the prototype has neither an anaesthetist hand-over flow (reassignList is admin only) nor Draft List assignment, so those host flows must exist first
OQ-43 open: warning wording, one vs two lists, whether each side sees the other
evidence: searched: blacklist|blocklist|naughty|block list in aa-prototype/src -> only unrelated WeekStrip 'Block list=' props
items.verify_note: Searched blacklist/blocklist/naughty/block list across src: no implementation. Added that the host flows (anaesthetist hand-over, draft assignment) are themselves absent, which raises the cost; OQ-43 means wording is a recommendation only.
items.title: Blacklist of anaesthetist and surgeon pairings

items.summary: No standard warning routine; prepayment is an enforced completion block (with office override) not a warning, and the other three listed warnings are not raised.
items.requirement_says: One routine checks Bookings and billable parties and raises text warnings (before/after-procedure, mild/strong), several per Booking, never blocking save, submit or authorise. Current warnings: unpaid prepayment, patient owing (mild under / strong over alert threshold), child as billable party, base units outside RVG range.
items.prototype_does: Prepayment status computed in selectors drives a BLOCK in completeCard and submit-sheet blocker list (liftable by audited office override); review-screen pills include prepayment outstanding/overridden and 'ACC should not bill the patient directly' (warn tone). Authorise is not blocked by flags. 'Prior balance' tag on billing monitor is presence-only. No child-as-billable-party check, no alert threshold, no base-unit range warning.
missing_or_wrong: Prepayment gate blocks completion (and submit via blockers) instead of warning: contradicts 'never blocks'
No unified routine or warning model (text, kind, strength, multiple per Booking)
No patient-owing warning with mild/strong alert threshold
No child-as-billable-party warning (guardian-pays-minor seed exists but raises nothing)
No base-units-outside-range warning
Warnings are not a per-Booking attribute surfaced in either app
items.demo_trigger: Control panel button 'Raise sample warnings' (Admin Day view and Card detail): applies a scenario to chosen Bookings so each of the four warning types shows, including a Booking with two warnings, then lets the presenter save, submit and authorise to show nothing blocks.
items.verify_note: Confirmed block at lifecycle.ts and that none of patient-owing / child / base-unit-range checks exist. Also noted existing ACC-bills-patient review flag is a warn-tone precursor that could be folded into the routine. Dropped nothing; the Contradicts (not Partial) call is right because a gate blocks where the requirement forbids it.
items.title: Warning routine

items.summary: No warnings to-do list or clear action on the admin dashboard; only adjacent Needs attention filter, Awaiting review rail and nav badges.
items.requirement_says: Admin dashboard lists open warnings from the routine as a to-do list; an admin can clear a warning once dealt with (optional for mild); new warnings appear, cleared ones leave.
items.prototype_does: Day view has a Needs attention focus filter and amber '!' for conflicts/surgeon TBC plus '$' prepayment corner; right rail lists Awaiting review lists; nav badges count review, billing and integration items. No warning list, no clear/dismiss action.
missing_or_wrong: No to-do list of open warnings on the dashboard
No clear action, no record of who cleared
Needs attention filter is list-level and not warning-routine driven
items.demo_trigger: Control panel button 'Raise sample warnings' on Admin Day view (shared with US-13.7.1): adds warnings that appear in the to-do list; clearing is done in the list itself.
items.verify_note: Looked for a Partial case: Needs attention filter and badges are weak analogues but there is no list of warnings and no clear action, so Missing holds. M assumes US-13.7.1's warning model is built first (shared work).
items.title: Warnings on the dashboard to-do list

items.summary: Admin day grid outlines Lists with attention flags and the card shows a prepayment banner, but no warning triangle with tap-for-text in either app and no warning confirm step on submit.
items.requirement_says: A Booking with a warning shows a warning triangle in both anaesthetist app and Admin App, tap shows the text; the admin day-view outline extends down to the Booking; submitting a Booking carrying a warning shows a confirm step.
items.prototype_does: DayGrid draws an amber border and '!' on Lists with conflicts/surgeon TBC and a '$' corner for prepayment; shared CardDetailBody shows a prepayment banner (both apps); Submit list sheet is a generic confirm unrelated to warnings (or a blockers list). No triangles on card rows.
missing_or_wrong: No warning triangle on Bookings in either app, no tap-for-text
Outline stops at List level and is not warning-routine driven
Submit shows no warning-specific confirm step (generic confirm only; blockers list is completion gating, which itself conflicts with US-13.7.1)
evidence: searched: TriangleAlert|AlertTriangle|ShieldAlert on card rows in apps/mobile apps/web shared/schedule -> only the CardDetailBody banner icon
items.demo_trigger: Control panel button 'Raise sample warnings' (shared with US-13.7.1) so the triangle appears on Bookings in mobile/web card lists and the admin List drawer, then Submit shows the confirm.
items.verify_note: Re-read DayGrid and submit sheet: List-level outline exists (partial credit), triangle and confirm do not. Nothing implemented contradicts this story itself, so Partial.
items.title: Warning flag on a Booking

items.summary: Epic body frames its children (first-release sync owned by EP-02, Future feeds/transports, NHI lookup) and states no rule or acceptance criteria of its own.
items.requirement_says: HL7 v2/FHIR integration is mostly Future Work; St George's and Southern Cross sync into the EP-02 matching screen in the first release; NHI lookup is in scope. Technical discussion (proposed) describes a transport-adapter tier with one queue, retry, failure handling and a per-hospital config matrix.
items.prototype_does: Has a full integration simulator (/demo/integrations) and admin Integration monitor: 3 feeds (St George's HL7v2, Christchurch Public HL7v2 misconfigured, Southern Cross FHIR), store-then-process, dedupe by MSH-10, retry, dead-letter, reprocess, editable per-feed field mapping. Messages are applied straight to Cards via guarded actions as the integration actor. No matching screen, unmatched queue, sync button or last-synced time.
evidence: searched: unmatched|matching screen|lastSynced in src -> none
items.verify_note: Re-read EP-14.md: body is scope framing plus a 'Technical discussion' of the proposed architecture, no criteria; the sync claim is owned by US-02.1.5. Confirmed no matching screen exists in src (grep). Cross-cutting conflict (feeds auto-apply to Cards vs 'nothing applied until admin decides' in US-02.1.5) belongs to EP-02 and is noted in epic_observations, not here.
items.title: Health systems integration

items.summary: Three standards each present in some form (simulated NHI lookup, hpiId on anaesthetist, NZHIS L4 subset), but HPI is labelled 'HPI id' not CPN, NHI lookup is a 6-patient stub, ethnicity is a demo subset.
items.requirement_says: Patient identity checked against the NHI FHIR API, anaesthetists referenced by HPI CPN, ethnicity coded to NZHIS Level 4; the identity standards Health NZ mandates, spoken by the integration from the outset.
items.prototype_does: NHI: 'Look up' button on shared ManualCardForm with demo badge 'NHI FHIR lookup · Digital Services Hub' calling canned lookupNhi (6 fictional patients). validateNhi covers both NHI formats. HPI: Anaesthetist.hpiId (fictional 6-char ids) shown/edited only in admin Add ('HPI id (optional)') and Edit sheet header, and emitted as FHIR Practitioner identifier (HPI_SYSTEM) in the integrations simulator; extracted from inbound FHIR but display-only. Ethnicity: 12-code NZHIS L4 demo subset with validator and quarantine/data-quality queue. Integrations callout says NHI lookup/Keycloak are referenced, not implemented.
missing_or_wrong: HPI labelled 'HPI id' everywhere (fieldLabels.ts:121, AddAnaesthetistFlow:72, EditAnaesthetistSheet:61); no 'CPN' naming, no CPN format check; not shown on any anaesthetist-facing or booking screen
NHI lookup resolves only 6 canned NHIs; any other valid NHI shows 'Not found'
Ethnicity coding is a curated 12-code subset of L4, not the full set (owned by US-11.1.1)
Inbound FHIR Practitioner HPI is ignored by the store effect (display-only)
items.verify_note: Re-opened nzhis.ts, ManualCardForm.tsx, hpiId usages via grep (no 'CPN' string anywhere in src), admin HPI fields, fhir.ts. Reviewer's points hold; added that inbound HPI is display-only. Feature body states its own rule (three standards) so Partial rather than Grouping. Nothing implemented is wrong (nothing contradicts), so not Contradicts.
items.title: NZ identity standards

items.summary: Only the automatic-application half exists (3 feeds auto-create/update/cancel Cards); the manual-matching baseline it phases from and the other five Christchurch providers are absent.
items.requirement_says: After the core system runs with a manual matching review like today's, the remaining hospital feeds are added and matching is automated as a second phase. The first release already includes automatic sync from St George's and Southern Cross (US-02.1.5), which only brings rows in for admin decision.
items.prototype_does: Integration messages from 3 feeds (STG, CPH, SX) are applied automatically through guarded actions (create/move/cancel Card, patient reuse by NHI, dedupe by MSH-10, dead-letter to admin monitor for failures). Surgeon PDF ingest samples exist for Forte Health and Christchurch Eye (admin reviews extracted rows). No manual matching screen, no unmatched queue, no feeds for Forte, Christchurch Eye, Burwood, Southern Endo or McMurray.
missing_or_wrong: No feeds/hospital entries or canned daily sheets for Forte Health, Christchurch Eye, Burwood, Southern Endo, McMurray Centre (US-14.6.1).
No manual matching review baseline (US-02.1.2/02.1.5): auto-apply is the only path, so 'manual first, automate later' phasing cannot be shown. Depends on the EP-02 matching screen.

Child-level (US-14.6.2, not feature body): exceptions (failed/unmatched) go to a dead-letter/monitor list, not an admin match-or-reject queue; hospital-supplied Contract (OQ-22) is not set by feed messages.
evidence: searched: Burwood|McMurray|Southern Endo in src -> none
searched: unmatched|matching screen|lastSynced in src -> none
items.demo_trigger: Simulator (/demo/integrations): add feeds for Forte, Christchurch Eye, Burwood, Southern Endo, McMurray with canned daily-sheet messages. Once the EP-02 matching screen exists, a control-panel button 'Deliver hospital sheet' (shown only on the matching screen, per feed) drops rows into the matching queue, plus a demo-only 'Auto-match on/off' toggle on that screen so phase-2 behaviour (routine updates applied, exceptions left for admin) can be shown.
items.verify_note: Confirmed Partial (not Contradicts): the feature body itself only says 'manual first, then automate'; the prototype's auto-apply is what phase 2 describes, so the wrongness sits with US-02.1.5/EP-02, not here. Confirmed no feeds for the five providers (grep). Trimmed the reviewer's Contract and exceptions points to child-level notes since the feature body does not state them. Size M covers only the extra feeds and the toggle; the matching screen itself is EP-02 work and would make the total larger.
items.title: Further hospital feeds and automatic matching

items.summary: Look up NHI on every add-booking flow (web, mobile, admin phone-advice) pre-fills the patient and is badged as the Digital Services Hub FHIR lookup, but it is a canned 6-patient stub with no validation feedback at lookup, no Hub states, no NHI refresh, no purpose-only statement.
items.requirement_says: System looks up and validates patients against the NHI FHIR API via the Health NZ Digital Services Hub when adding a Booking (web and mobile images show the lookup); anaesthetists referenced by HPI CPN; NHI used only for that purpose (HIPC 2020); NHI can be refreshed from the central register (hospitals get updates twice daily); Hub lookups part of dual-format regression.
items.prototype_does: AddCardFlow/ManualCardForm: NHI field + 'Look up' button (disabled when empty unless a prefill exists). runLookup calls lookupNhi (normalises via validateNhi, then 6-entry canned map): hit fills name, DOB, phone, ethnicity with 'Found X. Patient details pre-filled, still editable'; miss says 'Not found in this demo's records. Enter the details manually.' Same form reused by web ListDetailView, mobile routes and admin PhoneAdviceBooking (S2 empty-NHI prefill of DEM1239 fills a whole booking). createCard -> upsertPatient rejects an invalid NHI at save and reuses an existing patient by NHI. NHI is never sent to Xero or shown on invoices (incidental support for purpose-only), and the Xero sim callout says so. No refresh path.
missing_or_wrong: Invalid NHI (bad check digit / letters I, O) at lookup shows 'Not found', not a validation failure; validation surfaces only on save or in the integration monitor validator
Lookup limited to 6 canned NHIs; any other valid NHI cannot be shown as found
No Hub states: no loading, unavailable/timeout/error with fallback to manual entry
No refresh from the NHI register for existing patients, no last-refreshed time (twice-daily hospital cadence)
No explicit statement that NHI is used only for this purpose (HIPC 2020); only implicit via 'NHI never resides in Xero'
Anaesthetist HPI CPN reference not surfaced in the booking/lookup flow (stored as 'HPI id')
Hub lookup path not shown as part of dual-format regression in the UI (unit tests only)
evidence: searched: refresh.*nhi|nhi.*refresh|Privacy Code in src -> none
items.demo_trigger: Lookup already demoable via 'Look up' on Add booking (web, mobile, admin). Propose control-panel toggle 'Hub: Available / Slow / Unavailable' shown only while Add booking is open: Slow shows a loading state, Unavailable shows 'Hub unavailable, enter manually' with Retry. Plus 'Refresh from NHI register' button on admin patient/card detail that updates demographics from the Hub stub and stamps 'Last refreshed'.
items.verify_note: Re-read lookupNhi and runLookup; confirmed canned map, miss message, no validation feedback at lookup, no refresh, no CPN. Verdict stays Partial: the lookup concept is correct and visible, nothing implemented contradicts. Size raised S to M: Hub states + refresh action + lookup validation + generated lookup responses span domain, shared form, admin and control panel, plus demo-guide S2 and validator beats.
items.title: NHI lookup via Digital Services Hub

items.summary: Epic body introduces its six child stories and summarises them; the Technical discussion (Azure, Cloudflare, backups, DR, pen test, environments, support SLA) is RFP-response proposal with no acceptance criteria and no UI surface.
items.requirement_says: Cross-cutting NFRs: ease of use, enter once, mobile-first, testable billing rules, ~85 anaesthetists / 28,000 invoices a year; plus proposed hosting, security, DR, release and support arrangements.

summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype is a sound shell on the old RFP model; the catalogue has moved the model underneath it. Of the roughly 330 graded items across EP-01 to EP-15, most gaps are structural, not cosmetic. About 15 "Matches" are all in places the catalogue did not change (canvas generation, tiered time rule, Xero pair and webhook, audit viewer, AUTHORISED lock, NHI lookup stub). The rest cluster in four places: the schedule (Slot/List/Draft List), the Contract-replaces-route pricing model, the prepayment and money flow, and a missing warning model. Several rulings the prototype built as hard rules are now reversed: prepayment blocks completion, AA fee is a 5% deduction, cover is requested and accepted.
